title.zh: 小额资助付款记录协调员

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain award and payment records with clear links to supporting documentation.
requirements.zh: 维护资助及付款记录，并清晰关联支持文档。

requirements.en: Reconcile paid amounts against approved awards and identify scheduled future instalments separately.
requirements.zh: 将已付金额与获批资助核对，并单独识别计划中的未来分期款。

requirements.en: Report missing documents and upcoming payment milestones without making award or payment-approval decisions.
requirements.zh: 报告缺失文件及即将到来的付款里程碑，不作出资助授予或付款批准决定。
